shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical face
small circular/disc motifs within the relief
vertically stacked repeating relief units (glyph blocks in A, banded headdress elements in B)
justification: Both are upright monuments bearing shallow relief with small enclosed disc/rounded motifs and vertically stacked repeating units, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows only columns of framed, square sign-blocks with no figure, while B shows a frontal anthropomorphic figure with a banded headdress, pectoral discs and a belt \u2014 an entirely different subject and organisation of the surface.
